text: Unit prices are set out in Schedule A and remain fixed for the term of this Agreement.
A change to a unit price takes effect only through a written addendum signed by both parties, and never retroactively.
Addendum No. 1 dated August 5, 2026: from September 17, 2026, the unit price of Whiteboard 120x240 is changed to IDR 1,350,000.00 per unit.
The Buyer pays a complete and correct invoice within 14 calendar days of the invoice date.
Payment is made by transfer to the Supplier's account at Bank Permata, number 8132710382, in the name of Evergreen Office Supply Ltd.
Late payment accrues interest of 1.5% per month on the overdue amount.
